prompt:
Build a Simscape Fluids model of a high-pressure hydrogen refueling station. Hydrogen shall pass from a low-pressure supply through multistage compression with intercooling into a three-level cascade buffer. A controlled reduction valve and a precooling path shall then deliver hydrogen to a vehicle tank. The implemented physical paths must remain connected from storage to the vehicle.

Implement closed-loop vehicle filling. Measured vehicle-tank pressure and delivered-hydrogen temperature shall regulate the dispensing valve and the precooling action, while a supervisory sequence selects an available cascade buffer as the vehicle pressure rises. The system shall produce a bounded vehicle pressure ramp, safely manage delivery temperature, and stop commanded transfer after the tank reaches its target condition.

Read p_storage, p_vehicle_init, T_env, and T_fluid from the MATLAB base workspace. Their nominal values are 200 bar, 100 bar, 25 degC, and -60 degC respectively. The model must operate with p_storage from 180 to 220 bar, p_vehicle_init from 50 to 200 bar, T_env from 15 to 35 degC, and T_fluid from -60 to -45 degC. Record complete Timeseries from simulation start to finish for VehiclePressure_bar, VehicleTemperature_C, VehicleMassFlow_kg_s, ReductionValveCommand, and three-channel BufferPressure_bar. These must be physical or implemented controller measurements, not prescribed output waveforms.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XFLUID09.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
